watch.summary: The creator laughs as he watches technicians physically wrestle and subdue a small, malfunctioning robot thrashing on the ground.

beats.what: Creator compares the thrashing robot to a cockroach trying to stand up in his house.
The robot flails uncontrollably on the floor as multiple handlers rush to grab it.
Creator laughs and points out that the technicians are having to physically subdue the robot.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Not them having to subdue him.
watch.why: The visual of grown men wrestling a tiny, frantic robot to the ground is inherently funny, and the creator's joke about a cockroach enhances the visual comedy.
